description:
Inspect and refactor client-server synchronization to eliminate latency and state discrepancies:
- Address stale client-side overwrites where mutation responses overwrite updated subscription states.
- Evaluate pushing fully updated aim/phase payloads in WebSocket events instead of triggering client-side query round-trips.
- Investigate parallelizing server-side file listing to speed up full-project loads.
- Explore sequence numbers/versions for resource atoms to prevent out-of-order updates.

status.comment: Stale aim mutation/subscription overwrite race is fixed and tested. Broader payload-push, phase sequencing, and load-performance work remains.

reflection: Added monotonic per-aim client request revisions. Both updateAim mutations and subscription-triggered aim fetches claim a revision; only the newest response may replace local state, preventing a delayed mutation response from overwriting fresher subscription state. Regression test explicitly resolves the subscription refresh before a stale mutation response. Verification: focused MultiClient tests 3/3, full frontend unit suite 191/191, frontend type-check, and git diff --check passed.
